# Booked & Visible

> Booked & Visible helps independent local businesses in British Columbia, Canada get found on Google, Google Maps and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI results). Flat prices in CAD. Projects are one-time; an optional monthly plan is month to month. No contracts, no per-lead fees.

Booked & Visible is a small, independent business based in Langley, BC, run by one owner rather than an agency with account managers. It serves local service businesses such as trades, clinics, salons, professional services, retail, recreation and agriculture.

Products (all one-time purchases, CAD):
- Starter Kit, $129: six step-by-step guides and templates plus a personalized report within 1 business day of the intake form.
- Visibility Report, $79: a 0–100 visibility score using real answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI results, plus a prioritized fix list and a 90-day action plan, within 2 business days of the intake form. The $79 is credited if the customer orders the AI Visibility Boost or SEO Improvement Package within 30 days of receiving the Report.
- AI Visibility Boost, $199 founding price for the first 5 clients, $299 after that: ready-to-add schema markup, FAQ content and llms.txt, a business-details audit with a correction list, and a re-check at 30 days, within 5 business days of the intake form.
- SEO Improvement Package, $449 founding price for the first 5 clients, $599 after that: everything in the Boost plus a Google Business Profile tune-up, on-page SEO for up to 5 pages, up to 15 Canadian directory listings, a review system, and Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools setup, within 7 business days of the intake form and profile access.
- Stay Visible monthly plan, $79/month founding price for the first 20 clients, $99/month after that, month to month with no contract: 4 Google Business Profile posts a month, a reply to every new Google review within 2 business days, a monthly profile and business-details check, a monthly 0–100 score (full AI check every 3 months), a one-page monthly report, and a 90-day plan refreshed every quarter.
- Landing pages for businesses without a website: 1 page $329, 3 pages $429, 5 pages $529 (add $60 to have the domain registered for you), live within 3, 5 or 7 business days of receiving the content. The customer owns the domain.

If a Boost or SEO customer's 30-day re-check shows the score hasn't risen by at least 5 points (same searches and AI assistants as the first report), Booked & Visible finds out why, redoes any fix that didn't take, and re-checks once more at 60 days for free. No specific ranking, calls or revenue are guaranteed.

Contact: hello@bookedandvisible.ca · (778) 779-9166 · Langley Township, BC, Canada

## Key pages

- [Home](https://bookedandvisible.ca/): Overview of every product and how the service compares to pay-per-lead directories.
- [Pricing](https://bookedandvisible.ca/pricing/): All one-time prices in CAD.
- [AI Visibility](https://bookedandvisible.ca/ai-visibility/): How AI assistants see a local business, and the Visibility Report and AI Visibility Boost.
- [Stay Visible](https://bookedandvisible.ca/stay-visible/): Optional month-to-month upkeep for a Google Business Profile and AI visibility.
- [SEO Improvement Package](https://bookedandvisible.ca/seo-package/): Done-for-you local SEO: Google Business Profile, website pages, directories, reviews and AI search.
- [Landing Pages](https://bookedandvisible.ca/landing-pages/): Websites of 1, 3 or 5 pages for businesses without one, with a recent example.
- [What's Included](https://bookedandvisible.ca/whats-included/): What's in the Starter Kit and how the service works end to end.
- [FAQ](https://bookedandvisible.ca/faq/): Timelines, what customers need to do, refunds and ownership.
- [About](https://bookedandvisible.ca/about/): Who runs Booked & Visible and who it serves.
